cand.title: GDPM 2027: 10th International Workshop on Grapevine Downy and Powdery Mildews
cand.excerpt: Possible incremental Hotel Market if independently bookable demand is evidenced.
cand.recoveryAsk: HIGH deep research: verify dates, lodging mechanism, named lodging/meetings contact, YOTEL fit, competitor commitment.
cand.selectionWhy: 34-candidate commercial-quality queue · priority 1 · CORE_OR_NEAR · contact MISSING

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: No named 2027 lodging buyer, meeting purchaser or housing manager was verified. The official event route is info_gdpm27@agroscope.admin.ch. Two subject-relevant referral candidates are Dr Pierre-Henri Dubuis, Agroscope Mycology researcher at Changins and a published GDPM 2022 author, and Katia Gindro, Agroscope Mycology Group head. Their scientific affiliations are verified; 2027 organising responsibility and commercial contract authority are not. Olivier Schumpp is an additional Changins grapevine-research referral, not a verified buyer. Do not count these referrals as two verified commercial decision-makers.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming 10th edition: 13–16 July 2027, Agroscope Changins – Aula, Route de Duillier 52, 1260 Nyon, Vaud, Switzerland, in La Côte/Nyon territory. These are activity dates, not the Agroscope announcement publication date of 5 October 2026. Within the requested horizon. Official travel guidance: “Geneva International Airport (GVA) is located 25 km from Nyon, with direct trains to Nyon.” This is neither Lausanne nor French Pays de Gex.
findings.hotelProductFit: Assessment/inference using the supplied hotel specification: YOTEL Geneva Lake in Founex is geographically plausible for lodging associated with a Nyon/La Côte campus workshop, rather than central-Geneva convention overflow. The official event specifically supports Geneva Airport arrivals. Conditional offer: a modest delegate/speaker lodging allocation, with verified transport to Changins and breakfast timing; do not assume airport-to-Nyon rail serves the hotel directly. No room allocation or room-night forecast is defensible yet. Historical attendance was approximately 75 in 2014 and 30 in 2017, not a 2027 forecast; these suggest testing a small allocation rather than a whole-house or 120-room proposition. The conference itself is committed to Changins; six hotel meeting rooms are only a possible ancillary resource if separately requested. No resort requirement is published. Restaurant/banquet capacity remains unverified.
findings.venueCommitments: Officially announced meeting venue is Agroscope Changins – Aula, Route de Duillier 52, 1260 Nyon; a research-campus venue, not a competing hotel. This verifies venue designation, not access to the venue contract. Agroscope’s general site address is Route de Duillier 60; retain the event-specific Aula address 52. The meeting component is already assigned to Changins.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified international host rotation, not an annual Nyon meeting: Geneva NY 1991, Freiburg 1994, Loxton 1998, Davis 2002, San Michele all’Adige 2006, Bordeaux 2010, Vitoria-Gasteiz 2014, Corvallis 2017, Cremona 2022, then Nyon 2027. The 2022 previous-editions summary misstates the Italy/France/Spain years as 2005/2009/2013; contemporary proceedings and reports support 2006/2010/2014. The 2027 website describes a three-to-four-year series, but the 2022–2027 gap is five years. No next Swiss return or post-2027 edition was established.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Edition-specific official evidence: “Deadline for booking pre-reserved hotel rooms: 31 March 2027.” Thus an accommodation arrangement exists; this is not evidence of an open RFP. The site directs delegates to Practical Information, but that linked page could not be retrieved and no alternative official text exposed the details. No 2027 hotel name, housing bureau, direct-booking instruction, booking code, rate, block size, exclusivity, or contractual commitment could be verified. Independently bookable incremental demand remains unproven. General event enquiry: info_gdpm27@agroscope.admin.ch. Historical comparison only: the 2022 Cremona edition recommended Hotel Continental, Hotel Impero, Hotel Astoria and Hotel Delle Arti, with university-agreed rates and instructions to mention the workshop when booking; none is a 2027 incumbent.
findings.organizationStructure: Agroscope is the announced 2027 organiser and the Swiss federal agricultural research centre affiliated with the Federal Office for Agriculture, not an association, hotel, PCO or DMC. The series rotates among research hosts. Sciencesconf provides the event/registration platform; its presence does not establish a housing-bureau or PCO role. No separately appointed commercial intermediary or series legal owner was established.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Unspecified pre-reserved rooms create a real existing-accommodation constraint, but neither named 2027 competitor hotels nor exclusivity or mandatory booking could be established. No sell-out, overflow, displaced demand or open inventory evidence was found. The 2022 hotel list is historical only. Nyon-access convenience could disadvantage Founex unless transport is acceptable (inference); no sourced transfer time or delegate preference is available.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact info_gdpm27@agroscope.admin.ch now, referencing 13–16 July 2027 and the published 31 March hotel deadline. Request the accommodation sheet and named housing/procurement lead; establish every incumbent property, release terms, whether attendees can book outside allocations, and any unallocated speaker/delegate demand. Only after a positive reply offer a small, non-exclusive lodging allocation, suitable cancellation terms and a costed Changins transfer solution; no invented room volume or speculative full-conference proposal. Use Dubuis or Gindro for referral if the event mailbox does not identify the responsible administrator. Keep qualification conditional pending the reply.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the upcoming July 2027 edition, dates and meeting venue are confirmed; accommodation sales accessibility is unconfirmed. The 31 March 2027 pre-reserved-room booking deadline is a delegate-facing deadline, not a supplier bid deadline or proof that hotel sourcing is still open. Do not qualify as a confirmed open preferred-lodging opportunity until booking freedom, existing allocations and buyer authority are clarified.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Conditional strategy, not announced demand: ask whether YOTEL can be an additional non-exclusive option for 2027 without disturbing existing arrangements. For later cycles, maintain an Agroscope scientific-events relationship rather than assuming the next GDPM will return to Nyon: international host rotation is verified, but no post-2027 date, destination or Swiss lodging requirement was established.
